lines.text: Nate's daypack was stuffed with warm layers for a cold November hike,
so he left his spare bottle in the car.
By the last climb his only bottle was empty.
Here's the fix. Carry a collapsible bottle.
and once it's empty you squash it flat into a hip-belt pocket.
Now he carries both the layers and the extra water.
Save this before your next cold hike.
